title: Cosmic Elder in Bloom
description: An elderly Black man with a gray beard, glasses, and brown beret is depicted in the foreground wearing a vibrant blue and cyan patterned shirt. Behind him floats a translucent purple female figure with a headwrap, surrounded by swirling galaxies, ringed planets, glowing orange flowers, and intricate blue and green vines against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: An elderly Black man with white beard and glasses wearing a brown beret and colorful blue patterned shirt stands in the foreground, looking slightly to the side. Behind him a translucent purple ancestral female figure with headwrap floats among orange flowers and swirling green vines. Ringed planets, golden stars, and glowing cosmic swirls fill the dark teal background in a rich, painterly afrofuturist style with visible brushstrokes and dripping effects.
